name: Fujin
source: Fujin Municipal Natural Resources Bureau and Heilongjiang Tianditu public portal were evidenced as relevant custodians/platforms, but no public parcel feature service was verified.

queries.query: Fujin China official cadastral map parcel GIS Fujin City natural resources bureau
queries.result: Found Fujin Municipal Natural Resources Bureau official responsibilities page and Heilongjiang Tianditu portal documentation. No Fujin-specific public cadastral parcel viewer or downloadable parcel feature service was found.

queries.query: 富锦市 自然资源局 地籍图 不动产登记 GIS 地图 服务
queries.result: 确认富锦市自然资源局负责自然资源和不动产统一确权登记、权籍调查、不动产测绘及登记信息管理平台；确认黑龙江天地图门户公开地图/服务资源检索能力，但未发现可匿名访问的富锦市地籍宗地要素服务。

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Fujin Municipal Natural Resources Bureau / Fujin Municipal People's Government
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official page assigns the bureau responsibility for unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, registration information management, and public-service informationization. It does not publish a parcel API or parcel download.
Official information-disclosure guide identifies the municipal government website as the active public disclosure channel; no cadastral feature endpoint was identified there.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Heilongjiang Tianditu / provincial natural-resources geospatial portal
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Current portal is a SuperMap iPortal-style public GIS resource portal. Its inspected configuration exposes general imagery, vector basemap, city/county boundary and parking services; no Fujin cadastral parcel layer was identified.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Natural Resources Bureau page fetched; responsibilities and local custodian recorded. No parcel geometry or public parcel endpoint present.
Official information-disclosure guide reviewed; it points to the government website for proactive disclosure and does not expose cadastral geometry.
Current JavaScript/configuration inspected. Public portal resources and service URLs were followed without login or credentials; no Fujin parcel layer was listed.

Official current portal configuration inspected. It lists public basemap/imagery and boundary/map services, but no cadastral or parcel service. Configuration was read only; no private token or authentication was used.
Bounded anonymous metadata request to the configured Heilongjiang city-boundary map service failed upstream; no parcel schema or geometry was returned.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Fujin municipal registration/cadastral responsibilities and Heilongjiang provincial public GIS portal discovery.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official custodian pages and current public portal configuration only; no parcel feature response verified.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: Local registry/cadastral custodian is evidenced by official Fujin government material, but public registry parcel data access is not evidenced.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native ID if later exposed
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: No parcel attributes were requested or retained; no owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were accessed.

blocker: No anonymous, public parcel ID-plus-geometry response or downloadable cadastral dataset was verified. Serial review must independently determine whether a later authorized public source exists and whether its coverage, identity, CRS and legal/source semantics are admissible.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [47.2499763575058,132.028794949871] preserved in latitude/longitude order; it was not shifted and no exact-point hit or miss was treated as citywide evidence.
No sample GeoJSON retained because no safe parcel polygon and native parcel identity were obtained.
A map extent miss, service failure, or absent portal listing is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No login, credentials, private token use, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
Packet completion is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON was retained. If a future source is qualified, retain exactly one stable native parcel identity as properties.id and keep source field mapping in metadata.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently inspect any authenticated-free official Fujin or Heilongjiang parcel service that becomes available, verify stable native IDs, CRS/axis handling and coverage, and keep runtime held until qualification.
